chapter: Another Home There May Yet Be
act_title: Another Home There May Yet Be

quests.title: Another Home There May Yet Be

dialogue.section: Floating Hydro Fungus, Floating Hydro Fungus

dialogue.t: They've been here for a very long time...
I really want to do something for them so that they'll have a chance to meet again...
Yeah, and apart from these two Fungi, Paimon's also a little worried about the Floating Anemo Fungus's camp.
Mm-hmm. I feel the same.
I have an idea. Why don't we bring them over to live with the other Fungi?
Both sides have previously lived in the presence of an elemental life-form, so their habits should be similar.
Yeah, so they can look out for each other!
Would you like to come with us?
Looks like it's been convinced.
Okay, let's go.

dialogue.sit: After arriving at the camp, the two Fungi receive a warm welcome.

dialogue.t: Ooh, seems like the Fungi here recognize us. They're so friendly and gentle.
That elemental life-form must've been held in high regard by everyone living here.
Huh? Are you trying to play with Paimon?
Well, okay then! {NICKNAME}, Paimon'll be over there playing with the Fungi!
I owe you an apology. When the Fire Seed shattered while we were inside Apep... I had planned to sacrifice my power.
Did Paimon tell you that?

dialogue.sit: Yeah, and I was a little worried.
Yeah, and I was a little angry.

dialogue.t: I wasn't calm enough. I should've given it some more thought and made a better judgment of the situation.
When I realized that the Dendro Dragon was in danger and that Sumeru's safety was being threatened, I couldn't help feeling anxious and scared.
If I decided not to take action when things can still be done, or if time ran out before I've used up all my energy...
Using my powers may be the easiest way out, but it's also the most difficult.
Yes, and I think I learned a lot from them.
I understand what it means to have their wishes come true, but I'm still unable to accept it.
Why did it sound so peacefully content when it was doing something that just... makes you want to cry?
Looks like I still haven't fully grasped the concept of "empathy" yet...
Thank you for comforting me...
Feelings are really complex things, and there is still a lot for me to learn.
Huh?
They're even taking care of the crops... Are they simply mirroring the elemental life-forms' behaviors?
But since that Fungus even learned to speak, all of this might be due to the long-term effects of elemental power.
That's right. And now, we don't have to worry about the safety of these two Fungi anymore.
From now on, I'll be keeping an eye on this Fungi camp and come check on them once in a while.
I want to preserve the traces they left behind in order to create an opportunity for them to meet in the future.
After all, that Fungus remembered the name "Nur." Its memories came back.

dialogue.sit: I believe in their bonds as a family.

dialogue.t: Mm. Let's think of it as a beautiful wish then.
Nahida, the Fungi brought over some fruit! Come and have some!
Okay, I'm coming!

quests.description: The elemental life-forms’ “family” linger around for a long time. In order for them to be reunited one day, you have to first properly deal with the parting in the present moment…
